output.summary: Commit d989e56 changes three signatures: formatPrice(amount) gains a required currency parameter, tax(amount) gains an optional rate parameter, and config.json switches currency to EUR. The TypeScript callers that pass 'USD' match the new formatPrice signature. The tax callers that pass 0.2 match the new tax signature. Calls made through a method (Fmt, Calc) or a re-export alias cannot be confirmed from the shown code. legacyLabel imports a different formatPrice from ./legacy/price.ts, so it has no edge to the changed function.

groups.title: formatPrice gains a currency parameter
groups.description: The shared formatPrice definition changes its signature and output format. Review it first, then the callers that now pass a currency.

groups.title: TypeScript callers of formatPrice
groups.description: checkoutSummary, invoiceSummary and receiptSummary pass 'USD' through the import, which matches the new signature. viaMethod and aliasCaller reach formatPrice through a method or a re-export, so those links are only candidates.

groups.title: Python tax rate parameter
groups.description: tax gains an optional rate argument with default 0.1. order_total and refund pass 0.2 explicitly. use_calc changes its argument from 1 to 2 through a Calc method that is not in the diff.

groups.title: Unrelated label change
groups.description: legacyLabel changes only its string literal. It imports formatPrice from ./legacy/price.ts, a different module, so it is not affected by the signature change.

groups.title: Currency config
groups.description: config.json changes the default currency from USD to EUR. Check whether any code reads this setting and expects USD, because the diff shown has no reader.

edgeVerdicts.reason: checkoutSummary imports formatPrice from ./price.ts and calls it with two arguments, matching the new signature.
viaMethod calls f.formatPrice(2) on a Fmt instance. The Fmt class is not in the diff, so it cannot be confirmed that this method is the price.ts formatPrice.
invoiceSummary imports formatPrice from ./price.ts and calls it with two arguments, matching the new signature.
receiptSummary imports formatPrice from ./price.ts and calls it with two arguments, matching the new signature.

aliasCaller calls fmt(1, 'USD') from ./reexport.ts, which is not in the diff. The alias chain to formatPrice is not shown, so the edge is only a candidate even though the import resolution was reported as confirmed.
use_calc calls Calc().tax(2) as a method. The Calc class is not in the diff, so it cannot be confirmed that this method is the module-level tax function.
order_total imports tax directly and calls it with two arguments, matching the new signature.
refund calls t.tax(a, 0.2) through the module alias 't' from 'import tax as t', and the new signature accepts two arguments.
